_mechanism_key.M1_PERFORMER_TIER: the `base` seeded-performer tier: an identity-less, bald, cream-headed (#f5ead6) rig template admitted as an on-screen figure. forge.py:494-495 (`if n in chars:` — the `and n != "base"` guard was DELETED at commit 27bc7e2, 2026-08-06); seed_roles_text:1287-1291 ('an ANONYMOUS figure, not a recurring identity: it claims no name and recurs nowhere'). Blast radius 116/246 shots.
_mechanism_key.M2_POSE_VOCAB_GAP: the scene authors a bodily ACTION no library primitive covers; the STEP-1 card is minted on the nearest static stance (forge.py:1377-1378 — a pose-less card is told 'standing squarely at rest'), so the acting body and its hands are re-synthesized in the scene. 30 body primitives exist (registry: 17 pose + 13 action), none of them 'haul', 'shove', 'rake', 'reach into'. Blast radius: 91/154 figure-bearing scenes seed a card carrying a static stance.
_mechanism_key.M3_CROWD_PROSE_ONLY: crowd tier = ONE exemplar image granting 'only its anonymous crowd proportion and face tier' (forge.py:1317) plus the §2d clause as prose; visual-grammar §2 was amended at 27bc7e2 to state outright that 'a crowd-rig figure names no asset and carries no seeded pose or expression, so its expression and attitude are authored in plain prose'. The §2c rig-hold block explicitly EXEMPTS crowd figures from the four-digit-hand rig it states. Blast radius 66/246 shots declare crowd; 18 of them carry no cast seed at all.
_mechanism_key.M4_DELTA_CANONICAL_EXPRESSION_LEAK: a delta beat drops the figure's STEP-1 card and seeds parent + canonical only (forge.py:1734-1750). No seed in that slate is declared the owner of the FACE: the canonical role prose grants 'identity, head tone, hair and the pinned costume' (1306-1307) and the parent grants 'its held set and existing composition' (1309). The expression gate (913-920) fires only when the delta authors an expression DIFFERENT from the one its chain already holds (1715-1718), so a delta restating the held expression is ungated by design. Already diagnosed independently as 'CANONICAL EXPRESSION LEAK … a spec gap, not a generator lottery' (6c2-genlog.md STAGE 6b, L34). Blast radius 31/44 delta beats.
_mechanism_key.M5_UNANCHORED_ENVIRONMENT: a figure-bearing scene that declares no `place` and no chain parent seeds no plate, and is excluded BY DESIGN from the §5 scene style tile (forge.py:1834 `cast_free = not (fig_roles or canon_roles or crowd or anon_declared)`), so its whole environment exists only as prose. Blast radius 121/154 figure-bearing scenes.
_mechanism_key.M6_RETRY_CLASS_GAP: no repair class exists for a pose/action drift. A scene retry accepts defect content|seed|mechanism only (forge.py:2118-2119) and hard-refuses any additive instruction (2125-2127) and any expression word (_EXPRESSION_RETRY, 1981-1984); a STEP-1 retry accepts defect expression|rig only (2228). The 6c2 worker hit this exact wall and logged it ('a POSE/ACTION drift is neither, so the card itself cannot be re-minted through the sanctioned retry path').
_mechanism_key.M7_GATE_COVERAGE: the pre-gen human gate (SKILL.md Pass-1 step 2, 'HUMAN PRE-GEN APPROVAL — the gate. STOP.') covers only assets that earn a Pass-1 SLOT: named characters, groups, recurring props, and pose/expression/interaction primitives that must be BUILT. SKILL.md Pass-1 step 1 last bullet: 'Environments, plates, one-off props and anonymous crowds get NO slot.' In code the only forge-side gate is C-6 on STEP-1 figure-card REUSE (forge.py:1769-1775) plus a refusal to inherit a PARKED scene parent (2086-2088).
_mechanism_key.M8_SEED_CAP_DISPLACEMENT: FALSIFIED for this video. The ordered displacement added at commit 0e7e8d8 (crowd -> interaction template -> tagged prop, forge.py:1861-1906) fires ZERO times across all 246 shots: max seed count is 4, exactly ONE shot sits at the cap, and `assets_omitted` is empty on every scene. No card was ever dropped by the cap on bricks-fresh.

figures.name: base (seeded performer, costume key `l27-d4b1f2ce` = 'brown warehouse coat')

observations.daniel: the character is cream and bald. It's not a cast character. Doesn't make sense.
observations.evidence: the shot casts `base`. The card is minted off refs/base/base.png whose registry head_tone is #f5ead6 and whose role reads 'BASE TEMPLATE / rig anchor — not an on-screen character'; the derived dress clause supplies GARMENTS only ('Take from that description ONLY the CLOTHING it implies', forge.py:1380-1383) and nothing in the route can give it hair or another head tone. Cream + bald is the tier working exactly as specified, not drift.

observations.daniel: It just has 5 fingers (in a pose that wasn't seeded from anything).
observations.evidence: the seeded pose is `hold-one-hand` — a static two-hand-free hold — while the scene authors 'hauling a grey dust sheet off the front face of a shrink-wrapped pallet stack'. The card itself was fresh-eyes rig-verified 4-digit and is cited in 6c2-genlog.md as a PASSING reference for hand register; the acting hands in the scene are therefore re-drawn, not copied. The retry corrective ('BOTH hands closed on the sheet's leading edge, both full 4-digit rig hands at matched size') was authored, minted as L27-fix and passed 8/8 by fresh eyes — and Daniel still counts five fingers, so the prose route failed twice. SKILL.md's own seed law already forbids this: 'Exposed hands are seeded, never free-drawn … No library pose covers it -> that was a Pass-1 gate item, not an ad-hoc scene invention.'
